purpose: A by-reference foreach keeps the acquired array reference wrapper, not a frozen array value. After parked physical close, replacing the whole global wrapper value should expose the old payload cleanup while the new array remains through the retained wrapper after its global alias is removed.

<?php
class ReviewReferenceLoopOldA25 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewReferenceLoopOldB25 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewReferenceLoopNewC25 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
class ReviewReferenceLoopNewD25 { function __destruct() { echo "DNEW|"; } }
function reviewReferenceLoopRootLeaf25() { global $items; try { echo "C|"; foreach ($items as &$item) { unset($items); echo "V|"; yield 7 => 5; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewReferenceLoopRootMiddle25() { try { echo "M|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewReferenceLoopRootOuter25() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$items = [new ReviewReferenceLoopOldA25(), new ReviewReferenceLoopOldB25()]; $exception = new Exception("reference-loop-root25");
$child = reviewReferenceLoopRootLeaf25(); $middle = reviewReferenceLoopRootMiddle25(); $outer = reviewReferenceLoopRootOuter25();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|";
try { $middle->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $middle->current(), "|", $middle->key(), "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
$items = [new ReviewReferenceLoopNewC25(), new ReviewReferenceLoopNewD25()]; echo "WRITE|";
unset($items); echo "UNSET|";
unset($caught, $exception); echo "E";
